qa_pairs.question: What applications are currently supported on the Open OnDemand platform?
qa_pairs.answer: The Open OnDemand platform currently supports JupyterLab/Notebook, RStudio, VSCode, Trillium Desktop, ParaView, Forge DDT/MAP, MATLAB, Ovito, SAS, Stata, and Open Composer.

qa_pairs.question: How can a user request a new application to be installed on the Open OnDemand platform?
qa_pairs.answer: If an application is not listed among the supported options, users can request its installation by emailing support@scinet.utoronto.ca.

qa_pairs.question: Which Python packages are pre-installed with the default Python 3 (ipykernel) for JupyterLab on Open OnDemand?
qa_pairs.answer: The default Python 3 (ipykernel) for JupyterLab on Open OnDemand comes with numpy, redis, jwcrypto, jupyterlmod, matplotlib, h5py, cython, pandas, ipympl, jupyterlab_favorites, and jupyter-resource-usage pre-installed.
